submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective, context-independent detector of a fixed English lexical field: the pole fires at any token that is one of the 'inner conviction and repose' words - rest, trust, faith, peace, hope, doubt, belief, confidence, pray/prayer, believe, comfort, refuge, asylum, safe, secure, sleep, alone, remain - and at every inflection of them (rests/rested/resting, trusts/trusting, hopes/hoped/hoping/hopeful/hopefully, prayers/prayed/praying, believes/believed/believing, faiths, doubts) whatever words surround them, plus more weakly at congregation and public-affairs words of the same register (church, mosque, synagogue, worship, religion, fellowship, sanctuary, jury, trial, court, warrant, justice, evidence, terrorism/terrorist, embassy, team, squad, network, news, search) and at a few frequent stative/continuative tokens (am, now, still, away). It is silent on concrete nouns (apple, car, book, house), on other emotion words (love, hate, joy, grief, anger), on doctrinal religious vocabulary (god, lord, jesus, bible, holy, grace, mercy, sin, heaven) and on general abstract-state or institutional nouns (freedom, war, death, health, power, government, law, family, school).
